law001_explicit_delta_functional_form.name: Explicit Delta Functional Form
law001_explicit_delta_functional_form.purpose: Define a first explicit law-program candidate for δ(E > 0) as bounded admissible continuation selection.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Given a non-null local mismatch E_alpha > 0, δ returns the admissible set of continuation candidates available to locus alpha under local projection, transport coupling, and selection constraints.
candidate_law_statement.symbolic_candidate: δ(E_α > 0) := { x'_α ∈ A_α : x'_α = x_α + Π_{A_α}(Σ_{β∈CSI(α)} NavT(ω_α,ω_β)), and E_α > ε_null }
candidate_law_statement.important_note: This is a candidate functional form, not a proof of uniqueness, convergence, or physical correctness.
